title: Funding a feasibility study for East Maui Water Authority
summary: On October 11, 2024, the council voted nine to zero to file Bills 122 and 134, which would have spent $250,000 on a feasibility study and business plan for the East Maui Water Authority. The Director of Water Supply opposed using the Water Fund and recommended an engineering study of the East Maui Irrigation (EMI) water system, and the administration is to develop a new study proposal. The money was first added to the budget in 2023.

timeline.text: The committee voted to file, or set aside, both bills with eight ayes and one member excused.
